subject: tables: always append temp index values for unique index (#60340)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent (executor/table only). The change fixes unique-temp-index bookkeeping by fetching/decoding existing temp-index values during create (including double-write/merge states) to append rather than overwrite, and simplifies duplicate-handle lookup by deriving table ID from the key for temp-index paths (improving partition correctness). No remaining Blocker/High issues found in the touched executor/table behavior.
